name: color-to-vec3
title: Color to vec3
description: Converts any format of color to vec3 format for glsl/wgsl
author: MaximeHeckel

commands.name: convert-color-to-vec3
commands.title: Convert Color to Vec3
commands.subtitle: Convert a color into a GLSL/WGSL vec3
commands.description: Enter a color of any format and copy its normalized vec3 value.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
